name: Zinc Acetate

fda.text: For external use only. Flammable. Keep away from fire or flame. Do not use on deep or puncture wounds, animal bites, or serious burns. When using this product avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact with eyes, flush thoroughly with water. avoid contact with broken skin, do not inhale or ingest, contents under…

summary: Zinc Acetate is only for use on the outside of the body, catches fire easily, and must be kept away from fire, broken skin, eyes, deep cuts, animal bites, and serious burns [3]. The label also warns not to breathe it in or swallow it, and to flush your eyes with water if it gets inside them [3]. A small computer model, not tests on people, found low risk scores of 12 for the liver and 3 for the heart [M].
